player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} ed SimpleTak.
Ed board, ira bato mo so mairapen nga '{player_stone}' tan ira bato na kalaban mo so mairapen nga '{opponent_stone}'.

Ed turn mo, pilien mo met ung empty cell (no numero nga index) tan itakder mo ira bato mo edya.
No example, '[12]' itakder mo ira bato mo ed cell 12.

Objective mo so bumawa met ung continuous path na ira bato mo a konecta ira dua opposite edges na board (top-to-bottom o left-to-right).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Aliwan balido so format na iyalis
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Sala nga cell numero {cell_num}. Kinakailangan ya between 0 tan {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Say selda {cell_num} et wala la. Pamili na anggapoy cell to.

action.placement: Player {current_player_id} naitakder ira simbolo ({symbol}) ed cell {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Player {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') nikonecta ira dua opposite edges!
